definitions.full: H3679. Kasdim כַּשְׂדִּים proper name, of a people and territory Kasdim = Chaldeans, Chaldea , ᵐ5 Ξαλδαῖοι and ( Jer 50:10 ) ἡ Ξαλδαία (Assyrian (mat) Kaldu, Kaldû from earlier (Babylonian) form [* Kašdu] — š before dental becoming l , Dl Par 128 f. 200f.; Assyrian Gr. § 51, 3; Schr KGF 94ff. ; COT on Gen 11:28 ); — 1 Chaldeans: a. people dwelling on lower Euphrates and Tigris ; in proper name, of a location כ ׳אוּר Gen 11:28 (J), 11:31 (P), 15:7 (J), Neh 9:7 . b. especially the people ruled by Nebuchadrezzar ; — ׳כ Jer 37:10 ; 39:5 ; Ezek 23:23 ; 2Kin 24:2 ; 25:4-5 , 10 , 13 = Jer 52:7-8 , 14 , 17 ( 2Kin 24:5 ; 24:10 +? Jer 39:5 , 8 ), 2Kin 25:26 ; Isa 13:19 ; 43:14 ; 48:14 , 20 ; Job 1:17 ; Kt. כַּשְׂדִּיִּים Ezek 23:14 ; 2Chr 36:17 ; ׳הַכּ Jer 21:4 , 9 ; 22:25 ; 32:4-5 , 24 , 25 , 28 , 29 , 43 ; 33:5 ; 35:11 ; 37:5 , 8 , 9 , 11 , 13 , 14 ; 38:2 , 18 , 19 , 23 ; 39:8 ; 40:9-10 , 41:3 , 18 ; 43:3 ; 50:35 ; Hab 1:6 ; 2Kin 25:24-25 , ׳בַּתכֿ Isa 47:1 ; 47:5 = Babylon (in dirge); כ ׳אֶרֶץ ἡ γῆ Ξαλδαίων on locality see Schr Dl l.c .) Jer 24:5 ; 25:12 ; 50:1 , 8 , 25 , 45 ; 51:4 , 54 ; Ezek 1:3 ; 12:3 , also Isa 23:13 (inauthentic, Di Che; read כְּנַעֲנִים Ew Schr, or כִּתִּים Du); כ ׳וּלְשׂוֺן סֵפֶר Dan 1:4 ; כ ׳מַלְכוּת 9:1 . c. Chaldeans , as learned class, skilled in interpretations Dan 2:2 (+ מְכַשְּׁפִים אַשָּׁפִים חַרְטֻמִּים ), 2:4 . 2 Chaldea , לְשָׁלָל כַּשְׂדִּים וְהָֽיְתָה Jer 50:10 and Chaldea shall be despoiled ; כ ׳יוֺשְׁבֵי 51:24 , 35 ; מוֺלַדְתָּם אֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים Ezek 23:15 ; with ה locative: כַּשְׂדִּ֫ימָה 11:24 ; 16:29 ; 23:16 .
